We employ metrics to evaluate steering effectiveness and generation quality: • Steering Success Rate (SR): The percentage of generated outputs that successfully exhibit the target attribute. We use GPT-4o-mini as an automatic judge to assess whether the generated text reflects the intended attribute. • Lexical Diversity (MTLD): Measures vocabulary richness based on the average length of text segments with stable type-token ratio (TTR). We report ∆MTLD relative to unsteered outputs to assess changes in lexical diversity. • Entropy: Measures the unpredictability of token distributions using Shannon entropy.
